role: Independent source reviewer; no original product or backend tests edited. Catalog test author role is separate and catalog source final review is assigned to another reviewer.
initialSourceConclusions: Create/answer/retry/cancel serialize via room row, validate current authenticated owner and protocol, then CAS expected candidate/check state. Per-participant+kind+UUID ledger has length-prefixed command fingerprint and immutable original outcome; response recomputes current private snapshot.

Original candidate storage is separate from accepted submission. Only fenced CLEAR writes immutable accepted version and binds exact candidate; pending/failed/cancelled/late results cannot count as first completion. Existing accepted version survives later pending edits.

Publish checks exact check version, execution generation/token, current candidate, owner binding, open room/deadline. Accepted writes and automatic closure are one transaction with final deadline/open checks. No provider I/O inside room/admission transactions.

Guest configured production proof captures session/proof expiry and grant generation; publish revalidates session/proof/claim. REPLACE_ONLY cannot read snapshots and saves blind candidate without elevating proof or asserting completion. Account claim invalidates old guest binding.

Queue admission global advisory lock after room row; maximum queued100/inflight2, persistent execution deadline30 including queue, provider budget15/reserve3, one explicit retry and six physical admitted attempts per participant/room. Superseded/cancelled work retains consumed attempts.

V16 preserves original SQL1..15 and backfills existing rooms LEGACY before setting PRE_SUBMIT_V1 default. Four PostgreSQL tables have FK retention cascades, immutable candidate revisions, exact accepted version FK, bounded raw text and durable idempotency/execution records. Real DB upgrade/retention/atomicity gates remain required.

Final whole-room processor receives only accepted frozen submission versions, exact accepted-version interpretation anchor, and the existing final analysis provider. No per-person structured AREA/group output is generated or merged. PRE_SUBMIT_V1 legacy post-batch question writes are suppressed, while legacy historical behavior stays available.

PRE_SUBMIT_V1 HOST unapplied summaries suppress other raw inputs; ambiguity reasons do not expose another participant question. Own precheck routes require READ_OWN, return no-store, and persisted observations contain bounded status/usage metadata rather than raw data in metric labels.

Existing CLOSED correction path retains expected revision/round/frozen-participant guards. Snapshot accepted.confirmation_source is derived from exact actual submission-version linkage, avoiding candidate/submission revision-clock or equal-text inference.

confirmedNewOpenFindings.finding: Owner binding is checked before accepted SQL writes, but final guards recheck only room/check deadlines. A real session/grant can expire while accepted INSERT/bind blocks, allowing a late accepted commit under expired proof. Account claim is separately serialized by the room lock.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.recommendedFix: Revalidate binding after blocking accepted SQL/closure work; rollback all acceptance side effects on expiry and finalize stale ownership with a safe non-complete state in a separate transaction. Independent isolated PostgreSQL/clock oracle must establish the race before implementation.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.sourceRemedy: Two final owner/deadline fences throw out of transactional publish; separate rejectPublication preserves actual attempt usage and terminates only original exact version/generation/token/CHECKING claim.

confirmedNewOpenFindings.finding: Prompt/choice label may contain escaped U+0000, which is valid JSON string data but not storable in PostgreSQL JSONB. The asynchronous publish transaction can fail and roll back attempt observations rather than producing typed INVALID_RESPONSE. Application choice IDs also need SQL-safe validation; actual Gemini IDs are canonical A/B.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.scopeLimit: No configured live provider call; default capability flag is false. Client500 or log disclosure is not asserted as an inevitable consequence.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.recommendedFix: Reject NUL in all question string fields at actual provider and application provider-result validation boundaries. No semantic regex or field-limit changes.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.sourceRemedy: Actual provider boundedText rejects NUL. Worker independently rejects NUL in prompt/excerpt/choice ID/label/proposedText and rejects full proposal identical to source. Opaque bounded distinct application IDs remain supported.

confirmedNewOpenFindings.finding: Claim caches now and validates proof/open/deadline before potentially waiting on global admission advisory lock. If session/grant or room deadline expires during that wait, worker fresh remaining budget checks only execution deadline, allowing an unnecessary physical provider call after proof/room expiry; publish still fences acceptance.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.recommendedFix: After admission lock acquisition, refresh clock and revalidate proof/open/execution deadline reserve, then use refreshed claimedAt/startAttempt timestamp. Preserve room-to-global lock order and existing queue/concurrency/budget policy.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.sourceRemedy: claim now runs same rejection helper before and after global admission lock; fresh clock is used for permission/open/checkdeadline reserve, inflight count and claimedAt/startAttempt.

confirmedNewOpenFindings.finding: Plain-create default referenceAt and DIRECT explicit referenceAt are evaluated before potentially waiting for global admission lock, but candidate.createdAt is captured after it. A wait across midnight can change the intended relative date for newly saved plain/DIRECT text. A/B intentionally inherits the old source interpretation anchor.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.recommendedFix: Derive plain/DIRECT interpretation reference from the actual candidate persistence timestamp after admission lock. Preserve explicit inherited source anchor for A/B. Independent clock/advisory-lock oracle distinguishes these paths.
confirmedNewOpenFindings.sourceRemedy: Plain/DIRECT referenceAt defaults to null and resolves to candidate persistence now after admission lock. Explicit A/B inherited referenceAt is preserved.
